column1: # Campaign 23 source evidence for configured-table read-only BIGINT Selection planning.

column5: The configured single-table SELECT boundary parses and binds signed-BIGINT column-to-integer and integer-to-column comparisons joined by AND and rejects unsupported shapes before runtime admission; general catalogs, joins, subqueries, aggregates, windows, ordering, limits, DML, hints, and the complete PlanBuilder surface remain open.

The bounded planner builds one physical Selection above one table scan, retains projection columns first, appends deduplicated predicate-only columns, and publishes stable output offsets; general logical operators, optimizer rules, correlated plans, and property or statistics derivation remain open.

The configured signed-BIGINT scan carries table and column IDs, key and stored flags, projected columns, predicate-only scan inputs, and stable offsets for Campaign 23; ranges, partitions, indexes, statistics, costs, access paths, and the full PhysicalTableScan contract remain open.
